text: Infrastructure and Environment Committee will hear a presentation outlining workplace measures in place to ensure the health, safety and wellbeing for frontline Parks, Forestry, and Recreation workers.

The Infrastructure and Environment Committee: 1. Deferred consideration of the presentation (April 14, 2021) from the General Manager, Parks, Forestry and Recreation and the Director, Management Services, Parks, Forestry and Recreation to its next meeting on May 25, 2021.
